goals: Provide fail-closed Xaero Minimap radar-icon capture for the 37 Naturalist living entities whose rendered ModelPart hierarchy is not captured by Xaero's native path.

Preserve Xaero's native successful model and texture capture for Brown Bear, Bird, Butterfly, Catfish, Caterpillar, Crab, Deer, Firefly, Snake, and Snail; Brown Bear alone receives a narrow icon-only scale correction without modifying Naturalist, Xaero, EMF, or Ribbits.
scope: Use a closed Naturalist entity-id plus exact current model-class contract registry. Each contract selects the live renderer-selected adult, baby, or state model subtree; unknown class, path, trace, or draw failure delegates to Xaero's normal fallback.

After Xaero's native model prerender returns empty, render only the selected head/neck subtree for ordinary headed animals, or an explicit compact-body subtree for the documented non-headed anatomy families. The bridge copies only contract-path ancestor transforms and resolves only the selected part or its explicit ancestors' recorded trace; it never mutates or reparents the live Naturalist model.

Use explicit contract-local scale and rotation only for the C3 presentation corrections. Brown Bear remains on Xaero's native capture path and receives only a scoped icon-pose scale; no screen-space offsets are used. Evict the 37 fallback targets plus Brown Bear after resource reload so corrected results are retried.

exclusions: Naturalist source, artifact, version, controls, gameplay, networking, private assets, and renderer behavior remain owned by projects/naturalist.

Xaero, XaeroLib, Xaero × EMF, Ribbits × Xaero, vanilla entities, unrelated modded models, normal successful Xaero captures other than Brown Bear's scoped presentation pose, category/visibility settings, and cache entries outside the 37 target Naturalist types plus Brown Bear are not intercepted.

duck_egg and dirt_trail are not mob-icon targets. No static artwork, copied Naturalist or Xaero assets/classes, arbitrary class-name discovery, species-specific screen-space offsets, whole-model fallback for ordinarily headed animals, runtime deployment, or protected-gameplay-instance access is included.
